clean.tx: bágâ tɔgʊɛ ɟɪɪ gɪnɛ, bɛrgʊ tɛbɪ gɪnɪ.
clean.tl: Since the millet had been scattered, he said: “Take it!”’

flagged.tx: o wakil_amin_al iga Umam_al_Muttahida hifz_al_salaam kî tirogo Hervé Ladsous gine_îrì, [okîgu er kîí]gi, [“…”] gine_kîí.
flagged.tl: The UN Under-Secretary General for Peacekeeping, whose name is Hervé Ladsous, what this person said: [“”], he said.’ [5/1, 5.1]
